workflow.title: Woodland ADU preapproval designer submittal packet-presence check
workflow.scope: One made-up plan set prepared by a designer for City of Woodland ADU preapproval. This workflow checks reported item presence against the City's published designer requirements handout, which the City states is a summary and from which staff may request additional items. The preapproval submittal is site-agnostic: the handout asks for a placeholder sheet for a future site plan, so this workflow binds no parcel and queries no parcel dataset. It does not inspect files, verify designer credentials, determine legal sufficiency, certify completeness, or reproduce every item staff may request.
